BillingVerificationError.description: Returned with HTTP 503 when paid access cannot be confirmed right now: the billing provider is re-verifying a recently expired subscription, or the entitlement backend is unreachable. Retryable — honor Retry-After.

code.description: Machine-readable billing-verification state, mirrored in the X-Billing-Verification response header.

requiredTier.description: Minimum entitlement tier required for this endpoint, when the denial came from a tier gate.

marketBlendedProbability.description: Probability after the market blend and domain cap.

Error.description: Error is returned when a handler encounters an error. It contains a simple error message that the developer can customize.

message.description: Error message (e.g., 'user not found', 'database connection failed')

FieldViolation.description: FieldViolation describes a single validation error for a specific field.

description.description: Human-readable description of the validation violation (e.g., 'must be a valid email address', 'required field missing')

field.description: The field path that failed validation (e.g., 'user.email' for nested fields). For header validation, this will be the header name (e.g., 'X-API-Key')

ForbiddenError.description: Returned when a PRO-gated endpoint denies access because the caller has no resolved authenticated user, entitlements cannot be verified, or the caller lacks the required entitlement tier.

code.description: Machine-readable denial code, present when the 403 is a billing-provider-confirmed subscription lapse (mirrored in the X-Billing-Verification response header).

Projections.description:
Bounded presentation-path probabilities from domain curves.
 Market forecasts are peak-anchored, so the value at the forecast's own
 time_horizon can differ from the headline probability;
 non-market forecasts preserve their emitted horizon as anchor.

ResolutionSpec.description:
Resolution spec that makes a forecast scoreable. kind is "hard" (resolved by
 comparing metric_key from source_feed to threshold with operator ">=", "<="
 or "crosses") or "judged" (an LLM judge answers question). kind and deadline
 are always set; other fields apply per kind. baseline_value applies only to
 "crosses" specs. A judged spec's threshold is absent, never 0.

TriggerSimulationRequest.description: TriggerSimulationRequest enqueues a run for the current simulation package.

clientVersion.description: Optional client version, such as "mcp-client/0.2". Logged, never stored.

TriggerSimulationResponse.description:
TriggerSimulationResponse is the HTTP 200 result of an enqueue attempt.
 Errors return a non-200 status instead.

pkgFingerprint.description:
Opaque fingerprint of the package key; it changes when the key changes.
 Empty when reason='no_package'.

queued.description:
True when the task was newly enqueued; false on idempotency hit or
 no_package.

reason.description:
'' when queued, 'no_package' when no package exists, or 'already-handled'
 when this cycle's run is already queued or done.

runId.description:
Server-derived runId from SIMULATION_PACKAGE_LATEST_KEY. Empty
 string when reason='no_package' (no package pointer was available).

UnauthorizedError.description: Returned when the API key is missing, malformed, or lacks current API access.

ValidationError.description: ValidationError is returned when request validation fails. It contains a list of field violations describing what went wrong.

ApiKeyHeader.description: Alias header for the WorldMonitor API key (X-WorldMonitor-Key).

post.description:
TriggerSimulation enqueues a simulation run for the current package outside
 the hourly cycle. PRO-gated. Poll GetSimulationOutcome with the returned runId. Requires entitlement tier >= 1.

parameters.description: Optional client-generated idempotency key. Retrying a POST with the same key and an identical request body replays the original response (only the status, body, and Content-Type are reproduced) instead of re-executing; reusing the key with a different body is rejected with 422. For mutations this avoids duplicating the side effect, while for batch-read POSTs it replays a cached snapshot that can be up to 24 hours stale. Keys are scoped per authenticated caller (falling back to the source IP for unauthenticated endpoints) and retained for 24 hours.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

Idempotency-Key.description: The idempotency key echoed from the request. Present only when the client opted into idempotency.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: true when this response was replayed from an earlier request with the same key, false on the first (original) request. Present only when the client opted into idempotency.

400.description: Validation error, invalid Idempotency-Key header, or malformed JSON request body
